QF.id: VI Public Offering and Corporate Actions_7

question.text: When electronic payment instruments fail or bank details like MICR and IFSC are not available, what can companies do?

answer.text: Use physical payment instruments with bank account details of the investor mandatorily printed on them
Wait indefinitely until electronic details are available
Transfer the amount to IEPF immediately

explanation.text: The Logic: Where required bank details such as MICR/IFSC are unavailable, or electronic payment instructions fail or are rejected, companies or their RTA/STA may use physical payment instruments and must print the investor's bank account details on those instruments. The Trap: Forfeiture is not an option in this situation; the workbook permits physical payment instruments in the stated circumstances. Note: The page 185 wording focuses on when physical instruments may be used and on the mandatory printing of investor bank account details on them.
